item.title: Lincolnshire fundraisers urged to make waves as swimathon turns 40
item.description: WATER-LOVERS across Lincolnshire are being urged to dive into Swimathon 2026, as it celebrates four decades of swimming success. The sponsored event – now the world’s largest annual pool-based fundraising swim – is taking place at nearly 500 venues across the region and nationwide from 20-22 March. Pools set to take part include Yarborough Leisure Centre, Lincoln; Sleaford Leisure Centre, Sleaford; West Lindsey Leisure Centre, Gainsborough; Castle Swimming Pool, Spalding. item.title: Doorstep fraud: what to look out for
item.description: Doorstep fraud involves criminals knocking on your door and unexpectedly offering products or services. Fraudsters convince you to pay for goods or work which is often overpriced, or poor quality or is not even carried out. In many cases, this work isn’t even necessary.
